title: Gieringer Weiher Reith bei Kitzbühel
highlights: Dreamy moorland pond situated right inside the Bichlach protected landscape area
Therapeutic moor water and delightfully warm swimming temperatures in summer
Peaceful sunbathing lawns with shady spots beneath mature trees
Starting point for charming walks across gently rolling moraine hills
kurzbeschreibung: Gieringer Weiher in the Bichlach protected landscape area near Reith is a dreamy moor lake for nature lovers seeking serenity.
beschreibung:
Insider Tip in the Bichlach Protected Landscape Area

The Gieringer Weiher lies hidden in the gentle moraine landscape of the Bichlach between Reith and Oberndorf near Kitzbühel. This small moor lake enchants visitors with its untouched tranquility and dark shimmering, warm water.

Relaxation Far from the Crowds

Bathers will find natural sunbathing lawns, a small wooden pier, and a cozy kiosk buffet. The rolling hill landscape of the Bichlach with its small ponds and moors can be explored from the Gieringer Weiher along numerous walking paths.
